text_block_list.text:
One day, after running through countless 
races—

While sorting through Eishin Flash's past 
race records, something suddenly caught my 
attention.

"And the place I brought her to— was Tokyo 
Racecourse."
choice_data_list: This is where you won so many GIs.

text_block_list.text:
Not only had she achieved many victories 
in challenging GⅠ races, she had also 
consistently delivered results here at 
Tokyo Racecourse.
choice_data_list: That's an amazing record, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I remember every race I've run clearly, 
but I hadn't realized I had set such a 
record here at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A prominent one in recent memory would 
be... the Senior year Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to claim victory that day 
right before my parents' eyes."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And you were watching too, weren't you? I 
could tell how happy you were for me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Just that brought so many memories 
flooding back... Bowing felt like the most 
natural thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—That moment will surely be a memory I 
cherish for a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"It left an impression on my heart that 
was truly that powerful..."
choice_data_list: You were truly beautiful that day.
You were truly beautiful that day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much. I'm really happy.
choice_data_list: Let's share lots of memories today.
